Steps eight and nine: the real devices. Open the Align tool from the Tasks page, or from Setup. Your devices must be switched on and connected to this computer.
Find searches the network for every Lumi Node and every Giga Core. It takes a few seconds.
Now align. One device blinks: a Giga Core blinks its screen and port lights, a Lumi Node its LED's. Go to the device that is blinking.
Press its place in the plan, for example DB one, switch one. The link is made, and the next device starts to blink. Orange is the suggestion.
You can skip a device, or undo the last link. When every device has its place, go on to send.
Fill in from the plan puts the names, the VLAN's, the port names and the universes on the devices. Nothing is sent yet.
Send config shows every single change for every device, and nothing happens until you confirm. Changing an IP address makes a device move, so do that on a new network.
After sending, every device is read back and checked, so you know it really has the new settings.
